citation.title: Accelerating cell topology optimisation by leveraging similarity in the parametric input space
citation.authors: A. Martínez-Martínez, D. Muñoz, J.M. Navarro-Jiménez, O. Allix, F. Chinesta, J.J. Ródenas, E. Nadal
citation.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
citation.version_coded: version-of-record abstract only; full text inaccessible

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: A data-driven instance-based initializer places SIMP nearer to a local minimum and reduces the computation time for cell-level topology optimization.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: No numerical speed-up reported in accessible abstract.
claim.alternatives: Abstract also says the energy-based similarity metric is expected to work better for 3D cases; no quantitative classical comparison in the abstract.

baseline.problem_size: Cell-level topology optimization in a two-level framework; resolution not stated in abstract
